case_name: Smt. Suryamarathi Bhagyalaxmi vs The State Of Telangana

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Suryamarathi Bhagyalaxmi (wife) and Shyam Rao's son
parties.respondent_defendant: The State Of Telangana, respondent Nos.2 to 4 (Telangana State Northern Power Distribution Corporation Limited)

facts_of_case: Petitioner No.1 is the son of late Shyam Rao who died in service. Petitioner No.1 made an application for compassionate appointment but it was kept pending. He made several representations, but only after a lapse of five years, respondent No.4 passed an order rejecting his case.

legal_principles.principle: A family member of an employee who died in service is entitled to appointment on compassionate grounds, subject to specific conditions.
legal_principles.held: The BPMS 119 of the respondent Board dated 10.02.1982 states that a family member of the employee who died in service is entitled for appointment on compassionate grounds, subject to fulfilment of specific conditions.

legal_principles.principle: A person who contracts another marriage notwithstanding that the subsequent marriage is permissible under personal law is not eligible for compassionate appointment.
legal_principles.held: As per clause (xxi) of Reg.(4) of Telangana TRANSCO/TSNPDCL Employees Revised Conduct Regulations, No employee shall contract another marriage notwithstanding that the subsequent marriage is permissible under personal law.
applicable_acts_sections: Telangana TRANSCO/TSNPDCL Employees Revised Conduct Regulations

use_for_drafting: drafting a writ petition for land acquisition
